description: This header file declares utility functions and macros for thread management, including thread creation, naming, mutex initialization, locking, unlocking, and scope-based mutex locking in a concurrent programming environment using POSIX pthreads.

methods.name: createDetachedThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread that runs independently and is detached from its creator, returning true if successful.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread that can be joined later, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getThreadName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a thread given its thread ID; on Android, only supports getting the calling thread's name.

methods.name: mutexInitWithType
methods.description: Initializes a mutex with a specified type, such as recursive or error-checking.

methods.name: _mutexLock
methods.description: Internal function to lock a mutex, with error handling via file and line info.

methods.name: mutexLock
methods.description: Macro that calls _mutexLock with current file and line, used to lock a mutex with automatic error reporting.

methods.name: _mutexUnlock
methods.description: Internal function to unlock a mutex, with error handling via file and line info.

methods.name: mutexUnlock
methods.description: Macro that calls _mutexUnlock with current file and line, used to unlock a mutex.
